compiled_state.title: RED: 1500-issue pagination + JQL test
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: 1500-issue fixture across pages of 100 → fetcher returns all issues exactly once and differ produces stable, deduplicated mutation list

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists with 1500-issue fixture
  Verify: test -f tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py && grep -E '1500|range\(1,\s*1501\)' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py
- [ ] Test asserts new JQL string is passed to ACLI
  Verify: grep -F 'project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py
- [ ] Test fails against current fetcher.py (RED confirmation)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py; [ $? -ne 0 ]

## TDD Test Spec
Given ACLI stub yielding 15 pages of 100 unique issues (DIG-1..DIG-1500) then empty page; When collect(jql=new_jql) is invoked; Then snapshot dict has exactly 1500 keys, each DIG-N appears once, JQL sent to ACLI matches new JQL verbatim.

## Implementation Notes
- Create tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py
- Stub ACLI via monkeypatch (same pattern as test_fetcher_snapshot.py)
- 15 pages × 100 unique keys + terminating empty page

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
